say:5:1063201003:0.text: My deepest apologies for the disturbance. Let me introduce myself properly.
say:5:1063201003:0.source_cn: 很抱歉，我并不是故意要惊扰你们的。请允许我重新自我介绍。

say:6:1063201004:0.text: My name is Pandora. I come from another world... a wanderer with no home.
say:6:1063201004:0.source_cn: 我的名字是潘多拉，是来自另一个世界的……无家可归之人。

choice_prompt:7:1063201004.text: My name is Pandora. I come from another world... a wanderer with no home.
choice_prompt:7:1063201004.source_cn: 我的名字是潘多拉，是来自另一个世界的……无家可归之人。

say:8:1063201005:1.text: Do you see this box in my hand? This... was meant to be a divine gift for humanity. The gods appointed me its bearer.
say:8:1063201005:1.source_cn: 看到我手中的匣子了吗？它是众神送给凡人的礼物，而我是送...
say:8:1063201005:1.male: Do you see this box in my hand? This... was meant to be a divine gift for humanity. The gods appointed me its bearer.
say:8:1063201005:1.female: Do you see this box in my hand? This... was meant to be a divine gift for humanity. The gods appointed me its bearer.

say:9:1063201006:0.text: But I didn't know... the box contained all the calamities of the world.
say:9:1063201006:0.source_cn: 但我不知道匣子中装的，其实是世上的各色灾祸。
say:9:1063201006:0.male: But I didn't know... the box contained all the calamities of the world.
say:9:1063201006:0.female: But I didn't know... the box contained all the calamities of the world.

say:10:1063201007:1.text: The moment I opened it, everything I loved was swept away.
say:10:1063201007:1.source_cn: 我所爱的一切，都在我打开匣子的那一瞬间湮灭了。
say:10:1063201007:1.male: The moment I opened it, everything I loved was swept away.
say:10:1063201007:1.female: The moment I opened it, everything I loved was swept away.

say:16:1063201009:1.text: Don't be afraid. Those disasters are locked away—forever trapped in my world. They won't reach this place you call Esperia.
say:16:1063201009:1.source_cn: 无需惊惧，那些灾祸已经永远留在我的世界，不会危害到这个...

say:17:1063201010:1.text: The reason I'm here is because the only god who still had pity for the world left one thing inside the box for me—
say:17:1063201010:1.source_cn: 我之所以会来到这里，是因为唯一对世界心存怜悯的神，在匣...

say:19:1063201012:1.text: Now I understand... this "Hope" manifests as bridges between realities.
say:19:1063201012:1.source_cn: 现在看来，“希望”似乎是一个能够连通不同世界的隧道。

say:22:1063201013:1.text: Then... will you keep crossing worlds, Miss Pandora?
say:22:1063201013:1.source_cn: 那么……潘多拉小姐，你还会去别的世界吗？

say:25:1063201014:1.text: No, I've decided I won't open the box again. I don't know where that tunnel leads—or what might come through it.
say:25:1063201014:1.source_cn: 不，我已经决定不再打开这个匣子了。我不知道这个隧道通向...

say:26:1063201015:1.text: If those calamities ever found their way here... I'd be the worst kind of guest.
say:26:1063201015:1.source_cn: 如果那些灾祸，也来到了这里，我这个客人就当得太不礼貌了。

say:27:1063201016:0.text: However... if you have the courage to face the challenges that "Hope" may bring...
say:27:1063201016:0.source_cn: 不过，如果你有足够的勇气，去迎接“希望”带来的挑战……
say:27:1063201016:0.male: However... if you have the courage to face the challenges that "Hope" may bring...
say:27:1063201016:0.female: However... if you have the courage to face the challenges that "Hope" may bring...

say:28:1063201017:0.text: Perhaps I might open this box again... just for you.
say:28:1063201017:0.source_cn: 或许我会为了你，再次打开这个匣子呢。
say:28:1063201017:0.male: Perhaps I might open this box again... just for you.
say:28:1063201017:0.female: Perhaps I might open this box again... just for you.
